package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"

	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for transport_metrics_emitted_from_repository_layer: Repositories that record HTTP-route or handler-oriented metrics.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type MetricsClient struct{}

func (MetricsClient) IncrementCounter(name string) {
	fmt.Printf("counter: %s\n", name)
}

var metrics = MetricsClient{}

type UserRepository struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func (r *UserRepository) FindByID(id int) error {
	metrics.IncrementCounter("http.get_user.requests")
	metrics.IncrementCounter("route.users.get_by_id.calls")
	return r.db.Where("id = ?", id).First(nil).Error
}

func (r *UserRepository) FindByEmail(email string) error {
	metrics.IncrementCounter("http.get_user_by_email.requests")
	metrics.IncrementCounter("route.users.lookup.calls")
	return r.db.Where("email = ?", email).First(nil).Error
}

func (r *UserRepository) Create(name string) error {
	metrics.IncrementCounter("http.create_user.success")
	return r.db.Exec("INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES (?)", name).Error
}
